name: Prototype
config: One model. Research delegated with eve's built-in `agent` tool. No trace store, no evals, no guards.
solved: Task completion. It produced three costed wedding visions and emailed real vendors.
exposed: A research child was a copy of the root agent — it inherited `send_outreach`. Nothing measured whether the vendors were real, and nothing recorded what any sub-agent did.

name: Observed
config: Declared `scout` subagent (search + record_vendor only). KV trace store, LangSmith, per-agent live console, fixed eval sets.
solved: Visibility. Every agent's steps, tools, tokens and cost became watchable live, and the first eval put a number on research quality.
exposed: Two caterers recorded from directory listings, one with the email inquiries@hideseekmedia.com — a media company, from a page for a different business. Outreach is live: that inquiry reaches a stranger.

name: Governed
config: Gen 2 plus tool-level refusals: directory sources, vendor-mismatched emails, missing locations, dead source URLs. Search budgets. Transient-only retries.
solved: Correctness the prompt could not hold. Every recorded vendor now has an own-site source and an address that belongs to it.
exposed: Vendors outside the couple's travel radius — a band in Ohio, a photographer in North Carolina, 850 miles from a Massachusetts wedding.

name: Cheap (failed)
config: Gen 3 with the specialist tier swapped to DeepSeek-V4-Flash — $0.14/$0.28 vs $0.20/$0.60, 1M context. Specialists are ~80% of a plan's cost.
solved: Nothing. Kept for the record because it is the generation most write-ups omit.
exposed: 10 of 10 specialist sessions failed with OUTPUT_SCHEMA_NOT_FULFILLED and not one recorded a vendor. The cause was not only the model: an `outputSchema` on the subagent turned a formatting failure into a failed child session. The one-line economics swap is real, but only over a harness that survives it.

name: Production
config: Gen 3, outputSchema deleted (redundant with the research store), radius judged from town knowledge rather than searched for, models routed per role by measurement.
solved: Every category recorded 3-4 vendors: own-site sources, vendor-owned emails, stated towns, live URLs, photos on every venue, and 100% in-region across all five categories.
exposed: One florist recorded against a page on their own domain that 404s — real business, dead source. Now refused at record time.
